notes: Eleven source and seventeen target IDs each partitioned once.

The two-token toponym עֵין גֶּדִי is aligned token to token, with the chain's relational *of* on the first element; folding both tokens into one unit is the named alternative and is not required, since the English writes a word answering to each token.
s003 כֹּפֶר → *of henna flowers* keeps *flowers* as the supplied generic inside the substantive's own unit and heads on *henna* under rule 31, the word whose loss loses the lexeme.
Copula placement matches SNG.1.13: the לְ heads an adjunct and keeps only *unto*.
